rounds.summary: Coverage baseline, seven carrier quotes, gap findings, and open questions

cards.title: Which replacement offer keeps the current coverage at a verified final price?
cards.body: Compare against the current carrier's six-month renewal at $513. No policy is bought or cancelled until a quote is verified like-for-like.

children.title: Match the renewal coverage, not just the headline price
children.body: Liability 100/300/100, UM/UIM matched, $500 comprehensive and collision deductibles, loan payoff protection on the newer car.

children.title: Harbor Auto: $332 / six months
children.body: Last saved quote showed **$332 for six months**. License verification step was not finished, so the final price may move.

children.title: Keystone Mutual: $1,031 annual, paid in full
children.body: Proposal PDF quotes **$1,031 a year**. Coverage matches the renewal line for line, including payoff protection.

children.title: Northwind baseline deductibles: $323.25 / six months
children.body: Two proposals: $323.25 with $1,000 deductibles, or $360.22 with $0 comprehensive. Both assume a telematics discount.

children.title: Northwind lower deductibles: $360.22 / six months
children.body: Same proposal as the baseline with $0 comprehensive. Telematics discount still applied.

children.title: Pinecrest: $516 displayed, collision contradiction
children.body: Shows $516 paid in full, but the second car's collision line reads **No Coverage** while a $101 premium remains.

children.title: Lakeside / local agency: awaiting price
children.body: Credit disclosure acknowledged through the agency form. No priced offer yet.

children.title: Summit Mutual / local agent: awaiting price
children.body: Request sent through the agent's web form. No priced offer yet.

children.title: Prairie Farm Bureau: deferred
children.body: Deferred by choice. Do not restart as an automatic next step.

children.title: Redwood: route not completed
children.body: The online path required marketing consent, so it was stopped. Not a quote.

children.title: No alternative is yet a verified like-for-like replacement
children.body:
1. **Payoff protection:** get the actual payoff and decide whether to keep it.
2. **Telematics:** Northwind prices assume a discount that is not guaranteed.
3. **Pinecrest:** the collision contradiction blocks its price.

children.title: Document inventory and evidence limits
children.body: Original PDFs are referenced, not attached. Prices come from saved quote pages and proposal PDFs.

children.title: Does the newer car still need loan payoff protection?
children.body: Get the actual payoff balance before deciding. Do not assume positive equity.

children.title: What is Harbor Auto's final verified price and payment basis?
children.body: The $332 quote is unverified until license verification finishes.

children.title: What would Northwind cost without telematics and with matched coverage?
children.body: Ask for a standalone, no-telematics premium with matched UM/UIM and deductibles.

children.title: Can Pinecrest issue an unambiguous collision document?
children.body: Do not infer coverage from the premium or use the $516 price until it is corrected.

children.title: Will Lakeside and Summit return priced offers?
children.body: No price in any inbox as of this morning.

children.title: What is the current homeowners baseline for a bundle?
children.body: Bundle discounts are not comparable until the current home declarations are checked.

cards.title: Sortable comparison table: 11 detailed records
cards.body: Current and renewal baselines, five priced proposals, four pending or deferred routes.

cards.title: Detailed coverage tables and offer review
cards.body: Reference note with current and renewal tables and per-carrier analysis.

summaries.title: Price leaders still need correction or verification; Keystone is the closest documented match
summaries.body: Harbor and Northwind are cheapest but unverified. Pinecrest's price is blocked by a collision contradiction. Keystone matches coverage line for line at a higher annual price. Two quotes are still pending.
